analyst_view.overall: Early view: bottom against top. Eyupspor have 3 points and 3 goals from 11 games and changed coach to Mustafa Dalci in late September; leaders Galatasaray have won five in a row. Galatasaray will be without Rafael Leao (muscle injury, reported out 5-6 weeks and expected to miss this game) and Victor Osimhen had knee surgery with no return date yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.4 goals. Galatasaray remain clear favourites, but losing Osimhen, their top scorer, and Leao takes a lot of finishing out of the side, and Eyupspor's 3 goals in 11 games means the home side adds little; I lean slightly lower.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.7 corners. Eyupspor are likely to defend deep for long spells against the leaders, which tends to produce many blocked crosses and corners for Okan Buruk's side.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.9 cards. Eyupspor will have to chase and foul at times, but one-sided games against Galatasaray often stay calm; with no referee named, I stay with the number.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.2 shots. Galatasaray should have plenty of the ball even without Leao and Osimhen, so the volume looks right, though more of it may come from range.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.9 shots on target. Without their two main attacking threats, Galatasaray's chances may be of lower quality, and Eyupspor rarely threaten, so I lean a little lower.
